state:
- Specificity is exceptional: quantitative DHODH/ATP gates, longitudinal fate tracking and dual rescues distinguish mechanisms. However, an unspecified reference AML line could wrongly terminate this context-specific hypothesis. Test verified salvage-limited cytarabine-residual models and align stopping thresholds with achievable free exposure, rather than permitting a tenfold Cmax gap.
- Equal normal-cell DHODH flux and salvage does not falsify pyrimidine-mediated AML differentiation or prove absent selectivity. Separate mechanistic falsification from therapeutic-window failure; assess selectivity through normal colony recovery versus AML maturation and propagation.
- Novelty remains unestablished despite appropriate acknowledgment. Verify prior atovaquone–AML and respiratory-chain–DHODH studies, then identify the precise residual-state, timing or salvage-dependent prediction that those studies did not test.
